selection_criteria: Chosen on trading volume alone, before any price or margin data was examined (none was reachable from the build environment). Two classes: (1) CS2 weapon cases from the weekly drop pool era, the highest unit-volume item class on the Steam Community Market because every eligible account receives drops; (2) Field-Tested variants of long-standing, widely held rifle/pistol skins. Volume rank was not verified live; see DECISIONS.md D-15.
